verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents self-serve API credentials: you can mint, store, use and revoke a Personal Access Token, with a quickstart for a first authenticated call. The evidence pack shows no sandbox or test environment, and the registration docs say registration charges the account's billing method and isn't reversible, so the safe-testing half of the story is not delivered. Missing for 10: a sandbox/OTE test environment, non-billable test registrations, and test credentials separate from production.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get API credentials self-serve and test safely — a sandbox or test environment where registrations don't cost real money

citations.quote: Generate a PAT — create, store, use, and revoke a Personal Access Token (Bearer credential)
Quickstart — mint a token, make the first authenticated call
GoDaddy APIs use Bearer token authentication through a Personal Access Token (PAT) tied to specific capability scopes.
